gloss: water purification plant; water treatment plant

definitions.gloss: water purification plant; water treatment plant
definitions.explanation: A facility that takes river, lake or ground water and purifies it by settling, filtering and disinfecting so that it can be supplied as tap water.

examples.japanese: {浄水場|じょうすいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We toured the water purification plant.

⟦{浄水|じょうすい}→浄水：32126_jousui⟧ (clean water, purifying water) + {場|じょう} (place, facility). A common destination for elementary-school field trips in Japan.
